title: Credentialless parallel-stream playbook visuals
creator: Rina Patel
description: Design a compact set of onboarding visuals and screenshot templates that illustrate the new credentialless (device-code / tokenless) first-run experience for SDKs plus a parallel-streaming debug/playback view for developers. Assets must cover 1) hero onboarding banner, 2) in-doc step tiles (auth + ephemeral key), 3) streaming inspector frame showing multiple concurrent streams and tool-calls, and 4) a compact mobile thumbnail. Goal: reduce support friction for first-time SDK users and clearly show streaming + tool calling surface for quickstart docs.
acceptance_criteria: Hero PNG + SVG exported at 1920x600 with layered source in Figma
Three step tiles (Auth, SDK init, Streaming inspector) in two widths (900px and 600px) that match console style tokens
Streaming inspector mockup that demonstrates two concurrent streams, one with tool call icons and one with structured JSON output
A11y color-contrast validated, labels localized for en-US and fr-FR
Uploadable zipped asset package and a short writeup (README) describing usage guidelines
notes: This ticket focuses on visuals for docs and release banners; separate engineering work will enable the parallel-stream debug UI. Prioritize clarity for first-time SDK users who choose tokenless onboarding (device-code or ephemeral keys) and for teams who need to demonstrate streaming + tool calling in product docs.
decisions: Use a two-row streaming inspector: top row shows active streams (colored pills), bottom row shows decoded structured responses for one selected stream
Prefer neutral backgrounds with single accent color from Redwood product palette to keep emphasis on developer content
Include a small 'simulate tool call' overlay to show how tool actions are rendered in streaming output
